scope: Audit both published BTC test-period ledgers for return/position/cost reconciliation,window-boundary turnover,frequency and data integrity. No parameter search,new strategy or native LBank performance claim.

data.source_kind: Author-derived Kaggle price/position/return data,not original exchange OHLC/orderbook,raw imputation not independently reconciled.
data.selection: Both author-selected BTC windows,full released range AND common published clipped range. Do not choose best source/session/period after calculation. This is published exploratory historical evidence,not a new prospective or untouched sample.

source_rules: Completed EMAfast/slow comparison lagged1hour,always+1/-1;fast{5,7,10,15,20,30},slow{40,50,100,150,200};sourceWF7/28and14/10days with prior-window selection. Do not optimize or repair rules.
source_costs: Source gross log return=position*asset_log_return;source fees=.001*abs(diff(native parameter position)). Selected WF paths may differ at boundaries;compare source-implied turnover with actual selected-position turnover. Initial exposure is inherited/unknown;do not label uncharged initial position a verified newly opened trade.
fixed_calculations: Parse numeric RDS only using rdata1.0.0 and xarray2025.1.2,not R scripts/pickles/startup/DVC. Verify ZIP and member SHA before decoding.
Validate timestamp ordering,duplicates,1hour gaps,finite positive prices,+/-1positions,finite returns and overlapping/causal train/test boundaries;do not fill or close at missing data.

Reconcile source asset returns with price changes;infer charged transaction sides=(position*Asset_returns-source_return)/.001 and require near0or2. Compare with actual selected-position changes,excluding first unknown exposure and missing gaps.
Compare fee-only source logreturn and SAME selected signals recomputed at0.1%and0.2%per side;record boundary missing/extra fees,both full and published clipped periods,not only positive periods.
Daily mean log-return moving-block bootstrap7days,2000replicates,seed20261020,95%interval;diagnostic only,not an initial-R expectancy or untouched validation pass.

Count actual position flips and opportunity-day fraction;initial inherited exposure is not a new alert. Preserve closed segments between known flips,excluding inherited first and unresolved last;equal entry notional cash payoff side*(exit/entry-1)-fee*(1+exit/entry). Calculate base/doublefee closed-segment PF as diagnostic only.
Source cumulative exp(logreturns) drawdown percent is not initial-R drawdown. Do not infer TP1,5minute adverse excursions/urgent warnings,manual-fill latency or native funding from hourly closes.

Save original2BTC RDS ledgers,their parameter-window records/metrics,ZIP member hash manifest,actual results and closed-segment ledger. No strategy rerun or corrected complete execution backtest claim.
cost_limitations: Published .001cost is a modeled aggregate. Actual exchange fees,spread,manual slippage and funding unavailable;2xmodeledfee test does NOT satisfy full native doubled-cost gate. No leverage/risk increase.
decision_rule: Any source accounting defect or fixed frequency shortfall excludes this version as standalone manual-alert replacement evidence;do not relax thresholds or salvage tune. Even positive diagnostic results cannot qualify without full frozen SL/TP1/warning contract and all prospective/native gates.
